subject: Final-round interview logistics — Jordan Ellis (Accessibility request)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@gmail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, talentpartners@example.com
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final-round interview logistics — Jordan Ellis (Accessibility request)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with Redwood. Wed like to confirm the logistics for your final-round loop on Friday, Mar 5. Below are the details and a brief agenda; please reply to confirm or let me know if you need any adjustments.

Proposed schedule (PST):
- 10:00–10:20 — Intro / Hiring manager (Monica)
- 10:25–11:05 — Systems design (Aditya)
- 11:15–11:55 — Product & execution (Grace)
- 12:00–12:15 — Wrap and Q&A with recruiter

What Im providing: panel packet + final agenda (attached), interviewer briefing, calendar invite (link below). Please note the whole loop is ~2.25 hours including short breaks; we can add a 10-minute stretch break if helpful.

Accessibility note: if you need live captions, CART, or any other accommodation, we can enable Zoom live transcription and request CART through our vendor in advance — please tell me what will be most helpful.

Attachments: panel-packet.pdf, final-agenda.md
Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=zoom-final-round-12345
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PanelAssets

If the time doesn't work, we can slide the loop to 1pm Pacific — tell me which you prefer and well lock it in.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

--
Replying to the panel for scheduling visibility:

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@gmail.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, talentpartners@example.com
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final-round interview logistics — Jordan Ellis (Accessibility request)

Thanks so much, Laura — I can confirm Friday at 10:00am PST works for me.

One accessibility request: I use CART services for real-time captioning during longer interview blocks; could we either (a) enable Zoom live transcription and also arrange for CART, or (b) at minimum confirm that live captions will be on? CART is preferable for accuracy.

Also: if possible, Id appreciate a short 10-minute break between Aditya and Graces sessions (around 11:05–11:15) since a few back-to-back interviews can be tough.

Quick logistics Q: will the Zoom link require a passcode/password or a waiting room? I prefer the simplest flow to avoid audio delays.

Appreciate the coordination — looking forward to it.

Best,
Jordan
